title: Data on Companies Voluntarily Imposing Charge for Disposable Carrier Bag
what_it_is: Data on Companies Voluntarily Imposing Charge for Disposable Carrier Bag

sections.label: Bag charge monitoring and review
sections.summary: MSE and NEA will monitor the bag charge's effectiveness and review its impact after the first full year, and do not track retailers with voluntary charges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: My Ministry and the National Environment Agency (NEA) will monitor the effectiveness of the bag charge and review its impact upon the completion of the first full year of implementation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The charge applies to all disposable carrier bags, regardless of size.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE) and NEA do not track retailers that have voluntarily implemented disposable carrier bag charges and have no plans to do so.

sections.label: Monitoring bag charge impact
sections.summary: The member says monitoring will continue to assess the bag charge's effectiveness and impact and whether to expand the scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I think that would be useful to tell the effects of the bag charge that we have implemented on how many people out there are already doing it on their own, without the legislation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, we will continue to monitor the effectiveness, the impact and then assess whether we would like to expand the scheme.
